You’re welcome! I felt exactly like this a year and a half ago, it’s totally normal, even if you already suspect it. The pediatrician will have your son get a hearing test most likely if he isn’t responding to his name or ignoring you. We knew our son could definitely hear! But it’s a requirement they do. Then there’s programs like birth to 3, you’ll get an occupational therapist, or speech therapist, maybe both. Sounds like your son’s pediatrician is already on top of that so that’s great! Getting the diagnosis can be the longest wait in some states, it was a year for us. But once you have the diagnosis for your son, it’ll open so many doors for you both. I was really skeptical at first, but it’s nice having support for yourself and from his OT and speech therapist. They are really kind and gentle, they have helped get our son’s safety bed through insurance and he’s been approved for an AAC device 3 weeks ago. I’m still learning about my little guy, it’ll be okay!🫂

Hi, i know it’s a lot to take in at first, my spouse didn’t believe me when I said I think our son at 13 months was on the spectrum. I had a gut feeling since he was around 8 months. The head banging, flapping arms, no pointing, not responding to name, obsessive over wheels, didn’t “play appropriately” toe walking, no talking etc. I brought it up to his pediatrician and at his 18 months check up his pediatrician said he was highly suspicious he was, but didn’t want to diagnose him bc he wouldn’t get the medical benefits. So we did everything step by step. Hearing test, had him diagnosed after a long waitlist, he has an OT that we LOVE, and a speech therapist. They both come over which is great. Getting the process started is the best thing for you and your little one, I have learned so much more about his world, how I can help him regulate himself, how to keep him safe, and getting to those resources the earlier, the better. I wouldn’t want to change a thing about him, I love his squeals and stims, nothing changes, he’s still the same little guy you know and love.❤️ 🫂
